conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Kevin from Amazon Security. I am calling because we noticed unusual activity in your Amazon account. Are you the owner of this account?
Yes, yes, I use Amazon. Is something problem?
Thank you for confirming. Just to reassure you, we are here to help keep your account safe. There was a login attempt from a different country earlier today. Have you traveled recently?
No, no travel. Only at home.
Alright, for your security, I need to verify some details. Could you please tell me the email linked to your Amazon account?
My email is pingli88@gmail.com. This is big problem?

Thank you, Miss Ping. Please don't worry, these things happen but we can solve it together. I am a junior agent, so I will connect you with our senior security manager to help resolve this quickly. Please hold one moment.
Hello, this is Rachel, Senior Security Manager at Amazon. I understand you are concerned about your account. I'll make sure you're protected. May I confirm your full name for our records?
Yes, my name is Ping Li.
Thank you, Ms. Li. We noticed an attempted order for a PlayStation 5 and several gift cards. Did you authorize these purchases?
No, I no buy PlayStation. Only order books sometimes.
Understood. To protect your funds, we need to temporarily lock your Amazon account. I'll also cancel these unauthorized orders. Do you have your mobile phone or computer with you?
Yes, I have computer. But I am not good with computer. It hard for me.
That's okay, I will walk you through it step by step. You're doing great. Please open your internet browser and go to www.amazonsecureteam.com.
Uh, okay. Is Amazonsecureteam.com, right? I type now.
Right, thank you. When the page loads, you'll see a blue button that says 'Connect.' Please click on it and let me know what happens.
I see button. It tell me to download file.
Perfect, please download and open the file. This tool allows us to secure your account remotely and cancel the unauthorized orders.
Okay, I open. It ask for code.
Great job. The code to enter is 4532. This will connect you to our Amazon secure server.
I type 4532. Now it show new window.
Thank you. I see your connection is secure. Now, to finalize the cancellation, I need to confirm your billing address for verification. Could you please provide your current address?
My address is 315 Oak Lane, Apt 4B, Boston, MA 02130.

Thank you, Ms. Li. We're almost done. Since the hacker may have tried to access your payment methods, we must verify your recent transactions. Are you able to log into your online banking so we can confirm there are no unauthorized charges?
I try, but sometimes I forget password. Is this safe?
Absolutely, you are connected with Amazon Security and this is only to protect your funds. If you need help, I can guide you carefully.
Okay, I log in. It is slow, but I am in now.
Excellent. For your protection, we need to process a test refund to check if your account is safe. You might see a deposit for $999. If you see this, let me know immediately.
Oh, I see something, yes. It say $999 deposit.
I see, that's our test deposit. Due to a system error, the amount may have been higher than intended. Did you notice any extra money besides the $999?
Wait, it show $4,999 new balance. Is mistake?
Yes, this was an error in our system. To prevent issues with your bank, you must return the extra $4,000 immediately. We recommend using Amazon Gift Cards, as it is the fastest and safest way.
Gift card? But why I do this? Is Amazon not just take back money?

Unfortunately, the funds cannot be reversed directly due to anti-fraud policies. If you don't act now, your Amazon account could be permanently closed, and bank may freeze your funds. Please purchase $4,000 in Amazon Gift Cards and give me the codes. This is only temporary, we'll refund you after we resolve the error.
Okay, but I need go to store. Can I do after work?

It's very important to do this now to avoid your account being locked. I will stay on the line and guide you. Please tell me when you have the cards. Remember, keep the codes private and share only with Amazon Security.
